Why do we all light up when someone says well done?

Kevin explains how Cub Scouts, Little League and the bowling league taught us to crave the trophy, the stage and the star on the forehead from the teacher.

He says wanting recognition does not make you a narcissist. It is part of being human, and it has been one of the strongest motivators throughout history.

When did you last feel truly recognized for something you did?
